title: Council decision brief
description: The facilitator's synthesis that ends a council (stage synthesis), stored in councils.brief and shown in the council_decision gate. Also the output schema of the synthesis job: packs/schemas/council-brief.json is a copy of this file. Every object requires all its properties and forbids others, for runtimes with strict structured output. $defs text, level and assumption equal those of packs/schemas/common.json.

assumption.description: Something taken as true without confirmation. Forecrew registers it as A-n (docs/contracts/data-model.md, assumptions); docs/contracts/council-brief.schema.json repeats this definition.

statement.description: What you take as true, as one sentence.

confidence.description: How sure you are the assumption holds.

impact.description: How much the result changes if the assumption is wrong.

verify_by.description: How it can be checked: a test, a question to a human, or research.

question.description: The question the council answered, as framed in its brief.

options.description: Every option the council weighed, the recommended one included.

name.description: Short unique name, e.g. postgres-queue; votes and the recommendation refer to it.

summary.description: What the option is, in a few sentences.

cost.description: Effort and running cost compared with the other options.

risk.description: How likely and how bad a failure of this option is.

member.description: The member as role@runtime, e.g. architect@claude-code (council_contributions holds one member per role and runtime).

dissent.description: Members who disagree with the recommendation, in their own terms; empty only if nobody does.

member.description: The member as role@runtime, as in votes.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the recommendation rests on; each is registered.

open_questions.description: What the council could not settle.

reversible.description: Whether the decision is cheap to undo later. Judge honestly: an irreversible decision always goes to a human.

budget_exhausted.description: true when the council's token or time budget ran out and this synthesis uses what existed.
